reason: The receiver appears suited to collecting carbon dioxide at the capture unit, directly addressing one of the goals.
expectation: I expect the receiver to collect compressed carbon dioxide, though it may need another step.

alternatives.reason: I considered starting water electrolysis, but I am unsure how using water at one outlet relates to separating both gases.

effect: The capture unit produced compressed carbon dioxide and completed that goal, leaving water separation to address.
reaction: The result was straightforward and matched my expectation.
reason: I will start with the hydrogen outlet to work toward separating water into both gases. The options do not explain why the outlets are used separately.
expectation: I expect to obtain hydrogen from the water, though I am unsure how the oxygen will be handled.

alternatives.reason: The oxygen outlet also supports the remaining goal, but I have no clear reason to use it first.

effect: The hydrogen supply comes from one stream of the running electrolyzer; the oxygen outlet collects the other stream from the same process.
reaction: That explanation resolved my uncertainty about using water at separate outlets.
reason: The oxygen outlet is the only available combination and should complete the water-separation goal.
expectation: I expect to collect an oxygen supply from the same electrolysis process.

effect: Collecting oxygen completed the water-separation goal. The result also clarified that the lander will use oxygen as an oxidizer.
reaction: The distinction between oxygen and fuel was a useful clarification.

mostWorthwhile.text: Collecting hydrogen was most worthwhile because the explanation clarified that both outlets belong to the same electrolysis process.

leastWorthwhile.text: Capturing carbon dioxide was straightforward but offered little explanation of how the capture and compression worked.

surprise.text: I was initially unsure why water appeared at two separate outlets; the hydrogen result explained that they collect streams from the same process.

arbitrary.text: Choosing which electrolyzer outlet to use first felt arbitrary because the options gave no reason to prefer either order.

continue.text: Yes. The discovered specimen and the plan to return untouched ice make me curious about what happens next, though this chapter's actions were fairly straightforward.
